ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: If a dart is thrown randomly onto the dartboard shown in the figure, where each point on the board has an equal chance of being hit, what is the probability that the dart will land in the white region?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the diagram, let the area of each small triangle be $a$,\\
then the area of the shaded region is $6a$, the area of the hexagon is $18a$, and the area of the white region is $12a$,\\
$\therefore$ throwing a dart at the dartboard randomly, the probability of it landing in the white area is $\frac{12a}{18a}=\boxed{\frac{2}{3}}$.

Read from the image that the whole hexagonal board consists of 18 congruent small triangles total. Since the shaded region occupies 6 of them, the white region occupies 18 - 6 = 12 of them. Read from the text that the dart is equally likely to hit any point on the board, so probability equals area fraction. Thus the desired probability is 12/18 = 2/3.
